name: Baidu Cloud
short: ERNIE foundation models (current flagship ERNIE 5.1), multimodal APIs, and Qianfan enterprise AI platform services direct from Baidu; volumetric tier-based per-token pricing and a new-user free quota.

plans.name: API Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Volumetric tier-based pricing, e.g. ERNIE 5.1: input ≤32K = ¥4/1M in / ¥18/1M out; 32K–128K = ¥6/¥22 per 1M. DeepSeek-V3.1 is hosted at ¥4/¥12 per 1M; batch inference discounted.

plans.name: New-user free quota
plans.notes: Auto-granted on first activation of Qianfan: free tokens for online inference of preset models (ERNIE series, DeepSeek V3.x, Kimi K2, etc. - ~17 models), valid 3 months. ERNIE-Speed/Lite/Tiny postpaid service is also free (since 2025-05-21).
